title: The Covenant Between Solomon and Hiram
description: King Hiram of Tyre, who had been a friend of David, sent word to Solomon after he was anointed king. Solomon asked Hiram for cedar and cypress trees from Lebanon to build the temple for the Lord, promising payment for the workers. Hiram agreed to the deal and sent the timber as rafts along the coast. In return, Solomon gave him twenty thousand cors of wheat and twenty cors of fine oil each year. The two kings made a peace covenant. [ref:1 Kings 5:15-26|1 Kings 5:15-26]
